records.scenario: Booking a Tuesday train from London Liverpool Street to Cambridge, then checking Leverton House amenities

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for a train departing from London Liverpool Street.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I have several trains leaving London Liverpool Street. Where are you going, and when do you want to travel?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm going to Cambridge and need to arrive by 21:15 on Tuesday. Can you help with that?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes. There are eight trains that arrive by 21:15 on Tuesday. Would a train that departs at 17:39 and arrives at 19:07 work for you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That works, thanks. I need tickets for three people. Can you also provide a reference number once they're booked?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I've booked the tickets for you. The reference number is ZBGBFGTB.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. What can you tell me about Leverton House?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Leverton House is a four-star guesthouse on the east side of Cambridge. It offers free internet and parking.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great, thanks. That's everything I needed today. Bye!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a wonderful day!
